privacyNote: Tracking isn't surveillance. It turns worry into observation, and observation into a plan. Recovery signs count as much as warning signs.
privacyNoteCoach: Your log is visible to you and your coach.
privacyNoteDirect: Your log is visible only to you.

window.openBody: A consequence that already happened can open a brief window. It closes in about 72 hours. It's an accelerator, not the family strategy, not something to wait for, and not the separate They Said Yes clock.
window.sayText: “What happened is serious. You do not have to solve everything today. We have help ready, and we can leave now if you are willing.”
window.readinessReadyBody: Reconfirm the bed and admissions contact now, then follow the departure plan.
window.readinessBody: Don't improvise a planned conversation. Finish the logistics privately, but never delay help they're willing to accept now.
window.readinessUnavailable: Treatment readiness could not be opened
window.readinessUnavailableBody: Plan details are unavailable. Open the plan and restore access before relying on its status.
window.readinessSavingBody: Wait for it to finish saving before treating the plan as green.
window.readinessUnsaved: Treatment Action Plan is not safely saved
window.readinessUnsavedBody: Open the plan and save again. It isn't green until the save is confirmed.
window.closedTitle: Did a major consequence already happen?
window.closedBody: Do not wait for, provoke, or manufacture a crash. Keep preparing. Log this only after a real consequence has happened and they may briefly see what their use costs.
window.saveError: The consequence could not be saved. Nothing was changed.
window.loadErrorTitle: The consequence log could not be opened
window.loadErrorBody: Saved timing may still be there. Try again before logging anything new, so an active window isn't hidden or overwritten.
window.safety: Overdose, severe withdrawal, medical danger, suicidal behavior, violence, or immediate danger: call 911 or 988 now. If they ask for treatment now, act now with They Said Yes mode in the Treatment Action Plan. Don't wait for this clock or a checklist.
window.removeBody: Only if it was logged by mistake. Removing it closes the current window unless an earlier event is still active.

trajectory.title: Your trajectory
trajectory.subtitle: Six weeks of warning and recovery signs, side by side. Patterns show across weeks, not days.
trajectory.trendWorsening: Warning signs have been climbing lately.
trajectory.trendImproving: Recovery is gaining ground. Keep going.
trajectory.trendNone: Log a few weeks to see your trend here.
trajectory.selfCheckTitle: Is it time for an intervention?
trajectory.selfCheckSub: No right answer. Just notice what feels true. Nothing happens unless you choose it.
selfCheckItems: The same problems keep coming back, even with boundaries in place.
Their use is putting someone's safety at risk.
I've tried talking with them on my own and it hasn't changed things.
I'm running out of next steps I can take alone.
Other people who love them are worried too.
trajectory.selfCheckResult: Several of these ring true. Planning with a professional might help. You don't have to decide anything today.
trajectory.shareBody: Send your coach a note so they can see the trend and reach out.
trajectory.shareDone: Shared — your coach will see this.
trajectory.shareLocked: Turn on coach sharing in Settings to share your trajectory.
trajectory.shareNotIncluded: Messaging your coach is part of Essential and Premier. You can still send a free situation brief, or see the plans.
trajectory.shareMessage: I'd like to talk about how things have been trending over the last several weeks. Can we connect?
